questions.explain: Begin a transaction, seed data, execute, assert, roll back — no restores or cleanup scripts; database snapshots give read-only restore points for heavier fixtures; test security-critical procedures (RLS, validators, erasure) hardest.
options: Transaction-scoped fixtures: arrange, act, assert, roll back — test security-critical procedures hardest

questions.explain: Record real provider responses once into test_cassettes keyed by prompt hash, replay them in tests so application code runs identically; assert on application behavior (tools called, SQL generated, audit rows), and treat re-record diffs as regression signals.
options: Call the live model in every test
Record/replay cassettes keyed by prompt hash; assert on application behavior, not model words
questions.q: How are LLM interactions tested deterministically?

questions.explain: Every prompt, model, or retrieval change runs the golden set in CI; a faithfulness drop > 3 points blocks deployment; score history distinguishes real regressions from judge noise; every fixed vulnerability becomes a permanent adversarial test.
options: Gate deployments on golden-set scores; track score history; every fixed vulnerability becomes a permanent adversarial regression test
questions.q: How does the evaluation suite work as a regression suite?

questions.explain: Two load tests: vector-search concurrency (find the knee in latency/CPU — sets per-replica limits and autoscale triggers) and pool saturation (held streaming connections + bursts; size the pool at 130% of saturation) — always against production-shaped data.
options: Vector-search concurrency and pool saturation against production-shaped data; size the pool at 130% of saturation
questions.q: What load tests must run before launch?

questions.explain: Monthly chaos experiments in staging: kill the model provider mid-run (verify orphan reaper, partial state, no charges for failed tokens, resume works) and corrupt the vector index mid-traffic (verify graceful degradation) — plus quarterly 'break the bot' usability sessions feeding the golden set.
options: Monthly chaos experiments (kill provider mid-run, corrupt vector index) plus quarterly 'break the bot' sessions feeding the golden set
